title: 7 Things a Godly Man Does at Work Before Anyone's Watching Him
caption:
7 things a godly man does at work before anyone's watching him.

None of them are on his résumé. Showing up before the schedule makes him. Telling his boss the real number. Fixing his own mistake before someone else finds it. Small, unglamorous, repeated.

Whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men (Colossians 3:23). Nobody's grading most of this. That's exactly the point.

Save this for Monday morning.
